program_solutions:
(rule!
 ;; alt: compute numeric half ids qr/qc, then compare each cell's half id.
 (lambda (g)
   (let* ((h (rows g))
          (w (cols g))
          (mid-r (/ h 2))
          (mid-c (/ w 2))
          (cells (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w))) (cons r c)))
          (pos (find-first (lambda (p) (= 2 (at g (fst p) (snd p)))) cells))
          (target-top? (< (fst pos) mid-r))
          (target-left? (< (snd pos) mid-c)))
     (cellmap g (r c _)
       (if (and (eq? (< r mid-r) target-top?)
                (eq? (< c mid-c) target-left?))
           2
           6)))))
